name: Agassiz Village Summer Camp
description_short: Nonprofit overnight camp on Thompson Lake in Poland, Maine, for children from underserved communities. Campers ages 8-13 spend 11 days swimming, canoeing, on the ropes course, in arts and sports; teens 14-17 join the iThrive leadership program. Scholarships cover most of the cost, and transportation and meals are included.
